[1mnpx projectstore install[22m — Install projectstore's surfaces for a harness,
  behind a preview.

[1mUsage[22m
  npx projectstore install [options]

[1mOptions[22m
  --harness <id>   the harness — and, without a terminal, the confirmation (a
                   terminal is asked); there is no --yes (repeatable)
  --surface <key>  one surface and those beneath it (repeatable)
  --no-register    leave the plugin registration alone: change only this
                   project's files
  --verbose        every row's reasoning, each step's why and the host's own
                   notes
  --json           the envelope

[90mHarnesses[39m   claude-code, codex

[1mExamples[22m

  [36mnpx projectstore install --harness <id>[39m

  [90mThe same plan; nothing is written:[39m
  [36mnpx projectstore plan --harness <id>[39m

[90mExit codes[39m  0 ok, 1 findings or a refusal, 2 usage, 3 not bound, 130 cancelled
